mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in a 3-month window, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% in a 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) rise and industrial production (INDPRO) falls simultaneously, it indicates demand-supply imbalance causing inflationary pressures and monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS rises and INDPRO falls.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation periods (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY), a rising federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY and FEDFUNDS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly job gains exceed 250,000 (PAYEMS > 250), it signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when PAYEMS exceeds 250,000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months indicates robust economic activity that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO has increased over the past 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1,400,000 units, it signals a cooling housing market that reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when HOUST falls below 1,400,000.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment periods (UNRATE < 3.5%), a monthly increase in unemployment rate exceeding 0.1 percentage points signals an emerging labor market slowdown that reduces corporate hiring and earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE increases > 0.1pp in 1 month and UNRATE < 3.5%.
